# The Energy Boundary Behind Fusion Ignition

On December 5, 2022, an experiment at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory’s National Ignition Facility achieved fusion ignition. The experiment delivered 2.05 megajoules of energy to its target and generated 3.15 megajoules of fusion energy.

The announcement described the achievement as progress toward inertial fusion energy, while noting that many scientific and technological developments are still needed for practical energy production. The U.S. Department of Energy announced the achievement on December 13.
